progress.output: {"body":"\"Closes #365.\\n\\n## What changes\\n\\n- **Image collector for pi-durable** (`src/durable/images.ts`). `workspace.viewImage` reads the file with the same limits as on Pi (10 MiB source, 5 MiB encoded, 8 images and 16 MiB per invocation). It detects PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP and BMP from the file's magic bytes and base64-encodes the image.\\n  - With the new `PitDurableOptions.images` (an `ImageProcessor`, for example `await createNodePhotonImages()`), images are prepared to fit the model's limits: pi-durable's defaults, overridden by `inputLimits.images.resize`, capped at 5 MiB. The note says what was converted or resized and how to map coordinates back.\\n  - Without a processor, inline formats within the byte limit pass through unchanged, as with pi-durable's `read`. BMP and images that are too large fail with a clear error.\\n  - With a text-only model, the result says the image was left out (`omitted: true`), as on Pi.\\n- **Results carry the images** (`src/durable/tool.ts`). One `images.attached()` snapshot provides the metadata for `buildToolResult` and the `ImageContent` blocks added to `output`.\\n- **Images from nested tools** (`src/durable/tools.ts`). Images are attached in both branches, including tools with a `structuredOutputSchema`. Those used to drop their images with no notice.\\n- **Shared logic.** The bounded file read and the per-invocation slot and limit logic move out of `view-image.ts` into `src/workspace/image-attachments.ts`, which doesn't import `pi-coding-agent`. The Pi collector now uses that module too, with the same behavior.\\n- The durable entry still uses pi-durable only for types: the default limits are copied, and a test checks the copy against `DEFAULT_IMAGE_LIMITS`.\\n- Docs: `workspace.viewImage` is no longer listed as unavailable in the tool description, `docs/durable.md` and the README. `docs/durable.md` has a new Images section and an `images` option row, and the changelog is updated.\\n\\n## Tests\\n\\nThe stub's tests are replaced with Harness tests in `test/durable/harness.test.ts`. They check:\\n- the PNG reaches the model's next request\\n- the text-only note\\n- magic-byte detection\\n- refusals without a processor\\n- processor notes and limits\\n- the model's resize profile and the cap\\n- a nested tool with a schema that returns an image\\n\\nThe test host can now set the faux model's `input` and `inputLimits`. `delivery.validate` passes (static checks, tests, coverage).\\n\\n## For hosts\\n\\npi-action can opt in with:\\n\\n```ts\\nimport { createNodePhotonImages } from \\\"@earendil-works/pi-durable/images/node\\\";\\nfactory.create({ cwd, agentDir, trustProject, ui, log, images: await createNodePhotonImages() });\\n```\\n\\nWithout a processor there is no check on pixel dimensions, only on bytes. Very large PNGs within 4.5 MiB pass through unchanged, so hosts should pass a processor.\""}
